trigger: a reader of README line 80 or the changelog fragment after commit 9c53e99a1, or an operator on a macOS host whose /usr/bin/profiles cannot be started
classification_rationale: The prose generalised 'a failed read is CONSTRAINED' and 'a leg that throws is the only source of an unsupported row'; commit 9c53e99a1 made both untrue for a macOS spawn failure. Six reviewers found it independently in the same wave (docs-writer, enterprise-readiness, plugin-developer, consistency-auditor, cross-platform, compliance-officer).
summary: README line 80, README line 19 and changelog.d/2026-10-04-mgmt_posture.added.md still said every failed read or runner failure is CONSTRAINED. Fixed in 476099168 (README, fragment, regenerated plugin-docs JSON).

trigger: a maintainer reading mgmt_posture_macos.cpp after commit 9c53e99a1
classification_rationale: The header comment says every runner failure is CONSTRAINED; the leg now returns UNAVAILABLE for a spawn failure.
summary: Stale header comment in the macOS TU. Fixed in 476099168.

trigger: a macOS test host where /usr/bin/profiles cannot be started (a sandbox), running the live-plugin dispatcher test
classification_rationale: The else branch asserted constrained/CONSTRAINED/PARTIAL for any non-supported run, and its own example (a sandbox refusing the runner) is the spawn failure that is now unsupported/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN.
summary: Live macOS dispatcher test would go red in the environment its comment names. Fixed in fc87f720e: the branch accepts either shape with the matching status pairing. Not exercised on this host, where profiles runs.

trigger: enabled = True or TRUE with no [sssd] domains key, or a non-boolean such as yes
classification_rationale: A missing test (not a missing required doc): with the key absent, the case folding in enabled_of is the only route by which a domain activates, and dropping it left every test green. Labelled SHOULD by the reporter and kept there.
summary: Every fixture used lowercase true. Fixed in fc87f720e (True, TRUE, yes, empty domains value); mutation-checked: removing the case folding or accepting yes reddens the new parser case.

trigger: a future change to the leg's use of sssd_facts
classification_rationale: Missing leg-level pin of the operator-visible change (plane none for a declared-but-unlisted AD domain).
summary: L9 pinned the no_domains_key token but not the plane. Fixed in fc87f720e: new case L9c.

trigger: a maintainer relying on the posture_macos or execute_posture comments
classification_rationale: Comments overstated: 'status is forwarded' (completeness and line_limit differ from the classifier); 'pairs !tool_ran with spawn_error' (a pre-armed cancel or deadline can also leave tool_ran false); 'no status row is added' when the recovery throws (only the typed status may be missing); 'made valid UTF-8' (sanitize_utf8 still accepts overlong and surrogate forms, #4864).
summary: Four loose claims in two comments. Fixed in 476099168.

trigger: a future reader of two test comments
classification_rationale: Change-history phrasing ('was already none') and a count mismatch ('one respect' then two items).

trigger: an operator reading the README status table for a host whose sssd.conf has no [sssd] domains key
classification_rationale: The README never said what a no-domains-key sssd.conf reports, nor defined an active domain; the code behaviour changed in this range, the gap predates it.
summary: Fixed in 476099168: active is defined in the prose and the Linux CONSTRAINED row states the no-key case.

classification_rationale: The review's premise ('sibling plugins forward the classifier') holds for the ABI-forwarding plugins but not for the spawning posture plugins (pwpolicy:spawn_error, secedit:spawn_error and platform_security spawn_failed report CONSTRAINED). mgmt_posture is now the only posture plugin using UNAVAILABLE for a runtime spawn failure.
summary: A design divergence, not a defect: the mapping the reviewer asked for is kept and the divergence is stated in the commit message and in the PR remediation comment so the reviewer can ask for CONSTRAINED instead (a one-line change).

trigger: sssd.conf with an empty or blank domains value (for example a snippet blanking it)
classification_rationale: An empty key reports supported/none with no token, while an absent key reports CONSTRAINED plus no_domains_key. The reviewer judged it not a wrong answer: SSSD enables nothing either way and refuses to start with an empty list.
summary: Untouched by this range and accurate. No change; pinned by the new empty-value assertion in fc87f720e.

trigger: bad_alloc after the status row was written
classification_rationale: Two status rows (last wins) and rc 0 versus 1 asymmetry are the documented design shared with update_source_trust_legs.hpp; only the comment overclaimed.
summary: Behaviour unchanged; the comment was corrected in 476099168.

trigger: a transient pipe or fcntl setup failure in the runner
classification_rationale: spawn_error also covers transient runner setup failures; they now read unsupported instead of constrained. The token is kept, so a fleet view can still separate them.
